annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅关于印发《关于国务院行政复议案件处理程序的若干规定》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the General Office of the State Council on Issuing the Several Provisions on Procedures for Handling Administrative Reconsideration Cases of the State Council
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council of China)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese State Council General Office notice (Guobanfa [2026] No. 22, 22 July 2026) issuing provisions on procedures for handling administrative reconsideration cases at the State Council, delegating handling to the legal affairs department and replacing the 2001 notice. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Delegates handling of inadmissible reconsideration applications to the State Council's legal affairs department.
Upholding provincial/ministerial decisions generally needs no State Council approval unless significant.
Revocation or modification is negotiated with the agency concerned; disputes go to the State Council.
Provincial and ministerial agencies must submit replies and evidence and comply with rulings.
